item.title: Off to worst start ever, Atlanta United must win on Saturday
item.description: Atlanta United has yet to win a game this season, and after a 3-2 loss to Real Salt Lake, manager Gerardo "Tata" Martino emphasized patience and said the team had improved from last week's loss in San Jose. item.title: A surprising percentage of produce from the nation’s largest supplier contains ‘forever’ pesticides
item.description: Nearly 40% of nonorganic fruits and vegetables grown in California contain traces of pesticides that are also PFAS, or "forever chemicals," which can take years to decades to break down in the environment and have been linked to cancer, obesity, thyroid disease, and other health problems.
